title: A row lists where its links are
body:
coax makes links clickable. `link_runs` in its `src/ui.rs` walks every piece of every row, measures columns with unicode width, and merges neighbouring pieces of the same `Style::link` into one run with a row, a column, a width and the link index. Any program with clickable links needs the same walk.

## Proposal

`Row::links(&self) -> Vec<(Range<usize>, usize)>`: the columns each link covers in the row and the link's index into `Document::links`. cmr-b88cde lists this as follow-up work.
